The [resource catalog](catalog.yml) records external starting points without turning them into lab policy. Click a resource title or source link to open its external landing page. Annotations are intentionally short and original. Check the source landing page, current version, license, and access conditions before relying on a resource.

Some entries are authoritative standards or official guidance; others are practical references or orientation material. Inclusion is not endorsement, and users should verify that a resource is current and appropriate for their work.

Each entry has a stable ID, title, URL, author or organization, resource and authority types, topic tags, license, access date, relevant sections, a local research-note path, review status, and a short annotation. Unknown or unverified values are marked explicitly.

::: {.callout-warning}
Catalog inclusion is not endorsement. Resources may be useful, outdated, inaccessible, or governed by licenses that limit reuse.
:::

<script id="resource-link-enhancement">
document.querySelectorAll("td.listing-url").forEach(function (cell) {
  const url = cell.textContent.trim();
  if (!(url.startsWith("http://") || url.startsWith("https://")) || cell.querySelector("a")) return;
  cell.textContent = "";
  const link = document.createElement("a");
  link.href = url;
  link.textContent = "Open resource";
  link.target = "_blank";
  link.rel = "noopener";
  cell.appendChild(link);
});
</script>
